label: A mover other than the moved thing that… strengthens A mover other than the moved thing that…
note: Sibling readings of q.2 a.3 moventia secunda non movent nisi per hoc quod sunt mota (#151, DISAMB-PER-SE-LINK). The strong reading counts a second mover as a per se link whenever it is moved in any respect; the relevant-respect reading only when the respect is relevant to its moving. Strict but no countermodel is registered for the bare pair; AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-WEAK-READING-DOES-NOT-YIELD-UNMOVED-MOVER shows only that the weak premise set does not yield the absolute conclusion.
